description_en: Queries the task nodes of a task flow instance
description_zh: 调用GetTaskInstanceRelation接口，获取任务流运行记录的节点信息
name: GetTaskInstanceRelation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain the ID of the task flow
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution record of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html operation to obtain the execution record ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行记录ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
